admission_day.Description: Hospital admission calendar day relative to MRI acquisition day. MRI acquisition day is defined as day 0; negative values are before MRI.

age_at_admission.Description: Age at hospital admission in completed years. Ages above 89 are top-coded to 89 for release privacy.

clinical_pathway_status.Description: Clinical pathway status translated to standardized English.

discharge_day.Description: Hospital discharge calendar day relative to MRI acquisition day. MRI acquisition day is defined as day 0; positive values are after MRI.

gender.Description: Hospital-recorded sex recoded to M/F. Field name follows the release schema and should not be interpreted as self-identified gender identity.

main_discharge_diagnosis_en.Description: Standardized English label for the main discharge diagnosis.

main_discharge_icd10_cn2.Description: China National Clinical Version 2.0 ICD-10 code(s) for the main discharge diagnosis. Multiple codes are semicolon-separated; n/a indicates that no specific national extension was assigned.

main_discharge_icd10_who.Description: WHO ICD-10 parent/base code(s) corresponding to the main discharge diagnosis. Multiple codes are semicolon-separated.

treatment_outcome.Description: Hospital discharge treatment outcome translated to standardized English.
